correctness.rationale: The exterior-Koszul evaluation hyperplane fails only at a point where omega is decomposable x wedge v, necessarily rank<=2. On a line L=P(U), constant sections in kernel are W_omega intersect Lambda^2 Ann(U); their dimension is 5 or 6 exactly according to omega in U wedge V. All summands of F=E(-1) have nonpositive degree; rank nine and degree -4 force respectively 0^5(-1)^4 or 0^6(-1)^2(-2). For rank-four omega, exceptional U lie in support S and are Lagrangian for the inverse symplectic form, giving LG(2,4)=Q^3; rank six cannot have omega in U wedge V. The explicit published column sums annihilate a rank-six bivector, not rank four. Independent RREF F_3^4 count found 40 isotropic among 130 two-planes; finite count alone is not proof over C.
